intro: Lord Pythas, once a night elf warrior, is one of the four corrupted leaders of the Druids of the Fang in the Wailing Caverns. Originally one of the personal guards of the druid Naralex, he fell victim to the nightmare tainting the oasis underground. Now he wields both martial might and twisted serpent magic against any who try to reach his slumbering master.

p: Before his corruption, Pythas was a seasoned night elf warrior who served among the druid Naralex's personal guard when the expedition ventured into the dry wastes of the Barrens. Alongside his martial training, he took up the druidic arts in service of Naralex's dream of restoring lush life to the arid realm. However, physical discipline and martial valor offered no shelter against the insidious corruption waiting deep within the subterranean fissures.

When Naralex's connection to the Emerald Dream was hijacked by dark nightmares, Pythas's mind succumbed alongside those of his fellow acolytes. Abandoning his former loyalty, he became one of the leaders of the Druids of the Fang. Where his fellow serpent lords favor cunning spellcasting or beast forms, Pythas seamlessly blends lethal combat prowess with nature magic. He now prowls the winding tunnels of the caverns, determined to defend the nightmare's twisted grip on the cavern spring.
